summary: Root cause found for 'Error al agregar/eliminar tienda' bug. Backend PUT /api/auth/account/stores works perfectly (add/edit/delete all persist correctly via curl). The frontend bug is in StoresTab.js: it destructures `refetch: refetchAccount` from useAccount(), but AccountContext actually exports `refreshAccount` (not `refetch`). So `refetchAccount` is undefined -> calling it throws TypeError AFTER the successful axios PUT, triggering the catch block which shows the misleading error toast even though changes ARE persisted to DB.
passed: GET /api/auth/account/info returns account acc_06ca10fb49e1 with max_stores=2
PUT /api/auth/account/stores ADD new store: returns success=true, persists in DB
PUT /api/auth/account/stores EDIT store name: returns success=true, persists
PUT /api/auth/account/stores DELETE (via omission): returns success=true, persists

'Agregar Nueva Tienda/Caja' button visible and clickable
Add-store form fills and submits; backend persists (verified after reload: 'Tienda Test UI' appears in dashboard chart 'Ventas por Tienda' and remains after page reload)

failed.issue: 'Error al agregar tienda' toast shown on SUCCESSFUL add. Console shows: TypeError: refetchAccount is not a function at handleAddStore. Root cause: StoresTab.js line 13 uses `const { account, refetch: refetchAccount } = useAccount();` but AccountContext.js exports `{ account, loading, refreshAccount }` — there is no `refetch` key, so refetchAccount is undefined. Same defect affects handleSaveStoreNames and handleDeleteStore (edit and delete flows).
failed.evidence: Console: 'Error adding store: TypeError: refetchAccount is not a function at handleAddStore (bundle.js:38594:7)'. After add, error toast appears AND UI counter still shows '1 / 2', but after page reload the new store is present (backend persisted it). Dashboard chart 'Ventas por Tienda' shows both 'Tienda 1' and 'Tienda Test UI'.

failed.area: Frontend - UI does not refresh after mutation
failed.issue: Because refetchAccount throws, the AccountContext is never refreshed after add/edit/delete. UI shows stale state until manual page reload. This is the same root cause as the misleading error toast.
failed.evidence: Counter remained '1 / 2 tiendas' immediately after successful add; only became '2 / 2' after page reload.

action_items: Fix /app/frontend/src/components/settings/StoresTab.js line 13: change `const { account, refetch: refetchAccount } = useAccount();` to `const { account, refreshAccount } = useAccount();` and rename the three calls `refetchAccount()` to `refreshAccount()` in handleSaveStoreNames, handleAddStore, and handleDeleteStore. OR add `refetch: refreshAccount` alias in AccountContext.js provider value.
After fix, retest add/edit/delete flows end-to-end via UI and verify no error toasts appear on success and counter updates without page reload.
